title: Events: a modern filter bar with a date picker, removable active-filter chips, a result count and Clear all
detail: Owner list 2026-10-19 item 10. The library bar keeps the category tabs and facet menus and gains a segmented date picker (Any time, Today, This week, This weekend, This month) in place of the Date menu on desktop, and an active-filter row on every width: the result count, one removable chip per search word and filter, and Clear all. Every control stays a URL, so any view is shareable. Phone keeps the Filters sheet and quick chips (month added).
